purpose: High-risk Kannada spelling and public-content quality checks

rules.note: Use the standard spelling for language.
Use the standard spelling for student.
Use ಹಾರ್ದಿಕ in greetings such as ಹಾರ್ದಿಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು.
Use the standard formal plural dative form.
Both can occur in different lexical senses, so this is a contextual suggestion rather than a universal replacement.

grapheme_safety: Preserve Kannada combining vowel signs and virama sequences.
Never split a Kannada akshara into unrelated Unicode code points during correction.
Do not normalize a valid word merely because it differs by literary/spoken register.
Do not replace a word without checking its surrounding context.
